---
title: "Projects and Replications"
---

Use this area to record substantive outputs rather than course completion.

## Project template

For each project include:

- research question;
- economic/statistical assumptions;
- dataset and provenance;
- method;
- benchmark;
- implementation notes;
- robustness checks;
- results;
- what failed;
- possible research extension;
- link to code/notebook.

## Suggested progression

1. Reproducible empirical pipeline
2. Statistical-learning benchmark
3. Causal-ML replication
4. Transformer from scratch
5. Algorithmic allocation problem
6. Dynamic-pricing RL environment
7. Learned mechanism
8. Multi-agent artificial market
9. Relational foundation-model benchmark
10. Frontier research extension
